requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Could not achieve. Drawer present as drawer:1#0,0#cut on piece:0,0,1;half-n at 0,0,1. Spike previously placed at nearest available junction 0,0|1,-1|1,0 was removed when central piece was removed, and no spike socket exists at the identical corner as drawer; configurator enforces distinct corner/corner conflict (potential SPIKE_CLASH/MESH_CLASH or no socket). Build currently has drawer only, piece at 0,0,0 replaced with half-n but still unsupported, no spike at same corner.

finish.summary: Build does not meet requirement. Drawer installed but spike cannot occupy the very same corner as drawer - configurator offers no socket for coincident placement, implying mechanical clash. Current check_build shows UNSUPPORTED for half-n at 0,0,1 and loose bodies. Requirement unmet due to enforced rule.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
